Attached: 1 image

Forgejo v17.0.0 is out 🚀

The community-governed open-source Git forge (a lightweight alternative to GitHub and GitLab) just shipped a major stable release packing 25,848 commits since the previous version, with builds for linux-amd64 and linux-arm-6.

The update will be available soon on PikaPods.

Release notes: https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases/tag/v17.0.0
Run Forgejo: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=forgejo

#opensource #ownyourdata
